dedupe_keys.name: automatic survey of green roofs in london segmentation of aerial imagery dataset

description: This dataset maps green roofs across London, as polygons of roof area covered by vegetation, found by machine-learning segmentation of aerial imagery. It accompanies the paper 'An Open-Source Automatic Survey of Green Roofs in London using Segmentation of Aerial Imagery' by Charles Simpson, Oscar Brousse, Nahid Mohajeri, Michael Davies and Clare Heaviside of University College London. Coverage is the whole of Greater London. The main result is the estimated green roofs in 2021, with a secondary layer for 2019; the archive also contains the segmentation code and the analysis code, so the survey can be repeated on new imagery. Access: version 0.2 was published on Zenodo on 3 February 2023 as zipped GeoJSON files and code archives. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: polygons are buffered model predictions with classification errors, and the aerial imagery itself is not included. Simulation uses are urban heat and surface-water runoff modelling, nature-based adaptation planning and building-level retrofit potential. Related records: the Basel and Hamburg green roof case studies.
